summary:
I independently reviewed the complete newly frozen TASK-0138 specification 659c564c06db19d8f75d56bd814f4e5674afb0d864240ff2457be91a1916d8f7, the complete unchanged Node CI normative contract bound by Git/LF SHA256 196c46ac77e16ab8254f4f210796353bd44058153eeda5947931bec285fb9162, the exact one-paragraph specification supplement, actual strict task/risk/classification/events, previous REV-0001 and preserved failed refresh input. Ordinary CRLF checkout text is equivalent to the bound Git/LF Norm; raw fingerprints remain separate. The actual newly built design context is 0d2d69229960430e3f23a3bbfc3048d612ab8e7c456c19af9355e1966fa7c416. This is a new current design review, not reuse of the previous context or approval.

The actual governance checkout is on codex/agent-bridge-node-ci with HEAD and persisted subject 1641d85692e76b9e1f05e9fd3eed06633d6a5b31. The original task base remains 1f748a99b97842b9eca7abf4be454d348bf78759. Strict replay and the ordered real subject synchronization, resolution, classification and freeze events establish WAITING_FOR_SPEC_REVIEW with fresh REVIEW/V2 input 92744aff720a50e1d09408075e4679b14224abf0ba52d7d858acf84098a46c0d under unchanged native Policy. The earlier contract-only refresh failure, its input and events remain preserved; a genuine scoped schema commit supplies the synchronized subject. No subject or state was fabricated to bypass the classifier.

The only scope and DU impact additions are src/aiflow/contracts.py, src/aiflow/process_runner.py and the separately authored task-free tests/unit/test_process_runner.py companion transport path. Every prior scope entry and all other decision-unit risk, verification, permission, side-effect and protection facts remain unchanged. The specification otherwise matches the previous approved design exactly. This review does not amend the authorization files, default Policy, existing thresholds or original bases. Source-only publication permission A04 remains pending, and private target transfer and external execution remain outside this local amendment.

Adding node-ci solely to the existing fixed SCHEMA_FILES map is necessary for the already specified authoritative schema/resource registration invariant. It creates no arbitrary schema path, dynamic registry or validation bypass. The existing Windows Job byte reader is the appropriate shared primitive for authenticated official-client archive downloads; a second runner or HTTP/auth framework is unnecessary. The optional caller-owned binary stdout sink and explicit finite stdout bound are confined to that fixed download consumer. Existing Node/native defaults retain their exact one-MiB in-memory stream bounds, receipt shape and state-machine semantics.

The revised design explicitly preserves suspended start, process identity, Job assignment/membership, EOF, timeout, termination and confirmed cleanup. Streaming must enforce the installed tier archive cap incrementally before writes, retain partial originals, avoid whole-archive memory retention and reject short writes, sink errors, overflow or unconfirmed cleanup. It grants no arbitrary command/destination selector, credential export, automatic cap increase, default-limit relaxation, fake Current or source task write. Implementations and companion tests must still demonstrate these properties; this design review does not certify unimplemented code or replace the complete native and ordinary-kernel proofs.

The unchanged Norm continues to require the original-host live local Gate, exact source/engine/artifact/platform associations, complete distinct role originals, closed safe package membership and all required empty directories. No ZIP member omission rule is introduced by this scope amendment. CI capacities remain explicitly unregistered and non-runnable until bounded fresh physical-kernel measurement, independent concrete capacity review and the corresponding code/Norm/spec rebinding. All consumers must be complete before activation. Later packaging, authenticated download, source quality/code/Gate/exact-head checks, separately authorized target LOCAL and remote acceptance remain required in their existing order.

I find no actionable current design defect and no open critical/high finding in this bounded scope clarification; APPROVE is DESIGN only. I authored none of the implementation or companion tests. This record does not approve a spec/action/code transaction, execute a kernel or network request, register capacity, finalize evidence, pass a Gate, publish source, authorize target transfer or claim completed integration. Only the authorized immutable current design context/review, one appended review event and necessary task timestamp are persisted in the isolated governance checkout. The original root task, existing checkout raw event prefix, prior records, approvals, failed inputs and source/Norm bytes remain unchanged.
